test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

I told you that I had bought a new book for you the day before.

options.text: I told to you, "I have bought a new book for you yesterday."
I said to you, "I have bought a new book for you the day before."
I said to you, "I have bought a new book for you yesterday."
I said to you, "You have bought a new book for me the day before."

solution:
The correct answer is: **I said to you, "I have bought a new book for you yesterday."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is in **indirect **speech and we need to convert it to **direct **speech.
 
• When we change an indirect speech to direct speech, we must follow these rules:
 
 
• If the indirect speech is in the Past perfect tense, then to convert it into direct speech we need to change the tense form of the sentence. **Past perfect tense becomes Present perfect tense in the direct speech.**
 
• The reporting verb 'told' changes to 'said to'.
 
• **'Had bought'** changes to **'Have bought'** in the direct speech part.
 
• **"The day before" **becomes **"Yesterday"** in the direct speech part.
 
• A comma (,) is added after the direct speech part.
 
• The first word of the direct speech is in capital letters.
 
• The pronoun 'you' remains the same as the Indirect part.
 
 

Thus, option 3 is the correct answer. 

Hence, direct speech is- *I said to you, "I have bought a new book for you yesterday."*
